name: orchestrator-mcp
description: Dev-tools MCP server for the orchestrator ecosystem — write_findings pipeline contract (checks + issues + failures schema) for the checker, reviewer, and tester agents, and write_report (context_request + per-agent fields) for reader, writer, thinker, and researcher. Rejects checker/reviewer/tester findings with no checks[], and stamps written_at for freshness checks on both.
